history.summary: Small freehold boutique 2BR (76-unit project) on Changi Road, D14. The algo's -12.9% 'cheap-vs-district' is likely a district-median artifact (D14 median lifted by newer launches), not a verified bargain on the unit itself.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,568 psf ($928k) sits at the HIGH end of The Lenox's own band — project PSF range is ~$1,358-$1,765 and the 6-month average sale price is only ~$760k (smaller units). A directly comparable 592 sqft 2BR is separately listed at $1,604 psf, so the asking is fair-to-rich within the project, not cheap. Trailing appreciation 3.43% (19 txns) is unremarkable and has ~0 forward power per v3.4. Freehold is not a forward edge. Cohort depth is thin (8 txns) and a 'bedroom_sqft_mismatch' flag is open. D14 is RCR-ish (~+3.5% realized fwd) which is fine, but there is no dated catalyst to lift this specific unit.
red_flags: Asking $1,568 psf is at the top of the project's $1,358-$1,765 band, not cheap within the development
'bedroom_sqft_mismatch' flag in dossier — 592 sqft for a 2BR is tight, possibly a 1+study mislabel
Only 8 psf-cohort txns; -12.9% district cheapness is likely a district-median artifact
Geylang/Changi Road locale carries resale stigma and financing-quota considerations near the red-light zone
Nearest MRT (Kembangan/Eunos) is ~10 min away — not a transit-adjacent premium
catalysts: Freehold tenure (livability/long-hold appeal, but not a forward price edge)
Paya Lebar Central / Airport-area URA rejuvenation broadly supports D14 demand
